answer_1.quote: We perform our experiments on NMT models which we train on the German-English (de-en), English-Estonian (en-et), and Turkish-English (tren) news datasets from WMT18...

answer_2.quote: We use chrF++ and COMET as utility functions and always match the evaluation metric to the utility.

answer_4.quote: We confirm that our method is indistinguishable from standard MBR in human evaluation. On the de-en test set... we asked bilingual readers of German and English to state which prediction they preferred. We obtained 125 ratings.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were asked to indicate which of the two translations they preferred.
